detailed_description: The Tree Chart Generator builds an ECharts tree chart from an editable browser-side node table. You can edit node names, numeric values, and parent relationships, add nodes, delete non-root nodes with their descendants, clear the data back to a single root, set a chart title, choose a color theme, select orthogonal or radial layout, choose orientation for orthogonal charts, preview the chart, and download it as PNG or SVG. The tool starts with sample nodes and turns the flat node list into a simple hierarchy for the chart. It does not import JSON, CSV, YAML, URLs, or file-system data, does not provide a schema builder, weighted edges, conditional formatting, custom node styling, Web Worker processing, embeddable HTML export, accessibility auditing, or guarantees for very large trees.
usage_steps: Edit the sample node names, values, and parent selections in the data table.
Use Add Node to create more entries or delete non-root nodes you no longer need.
Set the chart title, color theme, layout, and orthogonal orientation if applicable.
Review the ECharts preview as the node table changes.
Download the chart as PNG or SVG when the preview is ready.
usage_examples: Sketch a small organization chart by editing parent relationships manually.
Create a radial tree from a short hierarchy of categories and subcategories.
Adjust orientation for a simple left-to-right or top-to-bottom tree preview.
Download a PNG or SVG chart for a presentation draft.
